title: Propagation of Serratia phage 92A1 and host
author: Adair Borges

steps.title: Streak Host Culture
steps.instruction: Streak culture out on an LB agar plate and incubate at room temperature (25 °C) for two days.

steps.title: Prepare Host Liquid Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 1 mL of LB broth with a single colony and incubate in a shaker at room temperature (25 °C) at 200 rpm for two days.

steps.title: Infect Host Culture
steps.instruction: Infect 200 μl of host liquid culture with 10 μl of phage in a microcentrifuge tube and incubate on the benchtop for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Top Agar
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.25% top agar and keep molten in a heat bath before use.

substeps.instruction: Mix 100 mL LB, 0.25 g agarose, and 100 μl 1M MgSO4
Microwave or autoclave to dissolve agarose

steps.title: Inoculate Top Agar
steps.instruction: Add the pre-mixed phage and host to 3 mL of molten 0.25% top agar in a glass culture tube once the agar has cooled to below ~45 °C.

steps.title: Plate and Incubate Phage
steps.instruction: Pour the inoculated top agar onto a room-temperature LB plate, swirl to distribute a thin layer, and let solidify undisturbed.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature (25 °C) for one day

steps.title: Harvest Phage
steps.instruction: Flood the plate with 3 mL of SM buffer and incubate on the benchtop for 10 minutes to allow phage to diffuse.

substeps.instruction: Prepare SM buffer using 50 mM Tris-HCL (pH 7.5), 100 mM NaCl, 8 mM MgSO4, and 0.01% gelatin (or purchase from Bioworld 41920012)

steps.title: Treat with Chloroform
steps.instruction: Pipette the SM buffer with phage into a 15 mL conical tube and add 300 μl of chloroform (scale up to 300 μl for every 3 mL buffer if combining multiple plates).

substeps.instruction: Mix on a rocking shaker for 10 minutes

steps.title: Centrifuge and Clarify
steps.instruction: Spin down the mixture at 15,000 × g for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: If the supernatant is cloudy, repeat the chloroform treatment and spin until clear

steps.title: Store Phage Supernatant
steps.instruction: Store the supernatant on 50 μl of chloroform in the fridge at 4 °C.
